summary: Phase D (AGRIOS Market Pulse richer templates + /api/config + dynamic provider switches) full-stack regression. 15/15 backend pytest cases PASS (after one minor projection fix). All frontend scenarios pass: buyer→/app/home, farmer→/app/farmer, digest provider badges MOCK+SHARE_ONLY with CSS uppercase class, regional snapshot (1 row for seeded data), new verified suppliers ('4 new cassava listing(s)'), copy-WhatsApp 'Copied' indicator, role-specific WA text, dormant=false for fresh users as expected. 3-variant subject rotation is deterministic per user_id (verified).

minor.issue: Mongo projection did NOT include text_bytes even though it is persisted on insert — fixed by adding 'text_bytes: 1' to the find() projection in server.py line 2541. text_bytes=387 now returned on mock send.

critical_code_review_comments: services/config.py effective-provider fallback is good for resend/sendgrid but payment.effective falls back to 'mock' only when FLAGS.real_payments is false — ensure any future 'stripe' addition repeats the same 'has-api-key?' check pattern as email does.

services/digest.py _subject_line uses md5(user_id) for stable A/B bucketing which is deterministic but if a user's subject under-performs, there's no way to rebucket without changing user_id; consider adding a SUBJECT_SALT env for global rotation.

services/digest.py render_whatsapp builds farmer bullets using price_guidance_delta of hot_crops (not of the farmer's own listings) — for farmers with zero listings matching hot crops this yields only the 'verified buyers were active' line, which may feel thin; consider falling back to 'List {top_crop} now' always when no guidance bullets apply.

server.py /api/digest/log projection initially missed text_bytes (fixed in this iteration). Recommend returning the log row as-is (minus _id) rather than a hand-maintained whitelist to avoid future projection drift.
server.py _run_digest_blast still sequential per user — already flagged in iteration_7; not regressed but worth queueing for Phase E.

Digest.jsx .uppercase class is CSS-only — the DOM text content is still lowercase. UI automation that asserts 'MOCK' from textContent will falsely fail; tests must check the class + value or use innerText with computed style.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing seeded listings/orders/users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D shipped green. /api/config is public & unauth. EMAIL_PROVIDER=mock, WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=share_only, PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock — all expected. Resend fallback-to-mock path is not exercised under current .env but logic in services/config.public_config() is straightforward. Dormant flow is only verifiable by manual user-DB manipulation (set users.last_login_at < now - 30d); seeded users don't satisfy it and is_dormant=False is correct. Playwright clipboard test requires context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=...) — otherwise 'Copy failed' toast fires which is a headless-browser env issue, NOT a real bug. Regional snapshot has 1 row (only Ogun State Tomato) in seed data — expected per agent note.
rca of the issue: Minor bug: text_bytes missing from GET /api/digest/log response. RCA: server.py's explicit Mongo projection enumerated html_bytes but omitted text_bytes when Phase D added plain-text alternate. The field WAS persisted (verified directly in Mongo: text_bytes=387). Fix: added 'text_bytes: 1' to projection. Retested — field returned on next send.
